naya.summary: Batch the maximum safe amount of work toward the current milestone; preserve verified state; apply cause-and-effect analysis before changes; never return to a lower rung without evidence.
lessons: Inspect → diagnose → repair → re-fetch → verify → test downstream → record evidence → prepare next command.
A fix that creates collateral damage is a regression.

human.summary: Stop the grocery-store loop of tiny partial actions. Each pass should move the system as far forward as safely possible and verify the work.
lessons: Prove the engine, preserve the proof, and climb without regression.

evidence: Both Naya and Shawn execution-discipline legacy notes were read; this event consolidates the shared lesson.
